title: Fraud_detection
summary: A script that generates a synthetic base dataset and trains a synthesizer to produce synthetic fraud-detection data with quality evaluation. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata schema, and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions to synthesize and validate the tabular data.
evidence: Fraud_Detection/fraud_data_synthesizer.py:4-6 imports CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic; line 62-66 instantiates and trains CTGANSynthesizer
